description: Shared Android/ArkTS semantic contracts for extracted Element X tasks 08-18

invariants: the main room timeline remains available and unchanged
focus does not replace the threaded timeline with the main-room timeline
a failed out-of-window focus never corrupts the current thread
the message is not emitted on the main-room timeline
any valid remote event can be the reply target
attachment relation remains scoped to the thread
nested media, location and poll flows do not reset thread context
failure keeps the original body and relation until retry succeeds
thread focus and composer state do not leak into the room timeline
home retains the selected Space while children update
existing order is stable and duplicate children are not added
joining one child does not change another child's state
failure and retry are tracked independently per room
invite handling uses the existing accept/decline semantics
direct messages are excluded and last-admin rooms are never selected by default
bulk actions and toggles cannot select a last-admin room
a failed leave does not report success or discard the current selection
only explicitly selected eligible children are included
loading server data does not block caption editing or cancellation
the fallback is exactly 100 MiB
changing image optimization does not fabricate video metadata
server limit comparison is inclusive
selection falls back toward smaller output without choosing an oversized preset
dismissing without a choice does not reset the valid selection
an oversized preset never silently replaces a valid selection
the client does not fabricate a sendable output size
retry reuses prepared media and the selected quality without losing the caption
existing room history remains visible
the old room history is not mutated
the underlying last message is retained
the predecessor event identifier is preserved
the ordinary room-beginning content remains visible
the predecessor event id remains available in timeline metadata
no report or leave effect is emitted
editing the reason does not toggle leave
the reason remains unchanged
reporting completes before the success result
leave is attempted only after reporting succeeds
leave preference remains selected
form values survive the failure
the successful report is remembered
the report is never submitted twice
clearing the error emits no network effect
self-session verification remains a distinct request type
current-session verification is not requested
the target user request remains active
the challenge data is preserved until a response is sent
the SAS challenge is unchanged
the user is not marked verified
the warning clears only after successful completion
cancellation never marks the user verified
reset creates no false success
unrelated member identities are unchanged
existing create-room and direct-message actions remain available
each address change invalidates the previous resolution
invalid feedback is suppressed before validation is requested
only syntactically valid room aliases are resolved
room navigation happens once
continue does not issue a second alias-resolution request
resolution failures do not close the flow
the resolver cannot leave the UI loading indefinitely
dismissing never joins a room
the entry is hidden when the server reports unsupported
no deactivation request is sent on entry
pasted newline characters are removed
the password is unchanged
a destructive request is never sent before confirmation
form controls are disabled while loading
the request is not duplicated
failure does not report completion
retry reuses the preserved form payload
dismissing an error does not submit again
identity reset cannot start without destructive confirmation
dismissal has no SDK side effect
concurrent calls reuse a loading or successful handle
the password reset screen receives the same SDK handle
fallback webview is used when a custom tab is unavailable
a missing handle is treated as failure rather than success
empty passwords cannot be submitted
a failed attempt does not destroy the reset handle
completion is emitted only after verified status
OIDC return and node destruction use the same cleanup path
the room timeline remains the navigation parent
a load failure is never rendered as an empty collection
the empty state is a successful load
event identity and server order are preserved
opening the action menu does not mutate the pinned list
server permissions remain authoritative
the pinned event remains pinned
unrelated pinned events remain in server order
a failed unpin never removes the item optimistically
message and call slots are loaded independently
changing the message sound does not change the call ringtone
no preference changes before the picker returns a value
the transient provider URI is not persisted as the effective sound
copy failure preserves the previous effective sound and version
changing the call ringtone does not change the message sound
the message sound and its channel version are unchanged
call-copy failure does not leak into message-sound error state
per-slot updates are serialized and a late completion cannot restore an older pick
legacy discovery never overwrites an explicit new preference
